title: CLAUDE.md
text: Respect rate limits — RIS OGD API public service; every request goes ris_base_request(), applies client-side throttling (30 requests/minute, .e. ~2s/request) retries — bypass add parallel/rapid sequential requests. matches officially documented pacing: RIS OGD FAQ (background_docs/ris-ogd-faq.pdf, “Technische Rahmenbedingungen”) asks clients insert “kurze Pausen von etwa 1–2 Sekunden” paginated page fetches — sequential, parallel. documented allowance concurrent requests, httr2::req_perform_parallel() option even though throttle bucket still cap (see background_docs/ris-ogd-faq.pdf ever proposing loosen parallelize ). OGD netiquette — follow terms RIS OGD API; attempt bulk-download entire database. FAQ also asks large/bulk fetches happen outside business hours (18:00–06:00) weekends, genuine bulk-download need announced advance ris.@bka.gv.isn’t mistaken DDoS attack — flag user rather acting , since requires contacting third party. Pagination — package handles multi-page results automatically via httr2::req_perform_iterative(); search/perform functions always fetch every page scope, user-facing cap. Narrow searches (e.g. date ranges specific filters) development testing keep number requests small. Slowness broad full-text queries (e.g. search_decision_text/search_legal_principles wide date range) expected — comes mandated per-page pacing across many pages, client bug; narrowing query way speed .

title: Build a RIS Case Law API Request — ris_req_case_law
text: application Judikatur application. Accepts RIS codes English aliases (case-insensitive): query Optional full-text query (Suchworte). Supports RIS full-text operators (space/und = , /ODER = , nicht = , * = wildcard, 'phrase' exact phrase). business_number Optional business number (Geschaeftszahl). norm Optional legal norm query (Norm). Multiple norms can combined /ODER (wrap norm single quotes, e.g. "'AsylG 2005 §3' ODER 'BFA-VG §21 Abs7'"). decision_date_from Optional lower date bound (YYYY-MM-DD, EntscheidungsdatumVon). decision_date_to Optional upper date bound (YYYY-MM-DD, EntscheidungsdatumBis). decision_type Optional decision type (Entscheidungsart). Allowed values depend application: VfGH: "Undefined", "Beschluss", "Erkenntnis", "Vergleich", "KeineAngabe" (English aliases: "order", "judgment", "settlement", "not_specified"). VwGH: "Undefined", "Beschluss", "Erkenntnis", "BeschlussVS", "ErkenntnisVS". BVwG: "Undefined", "Beschluss", "Erkenntnis". LVwG / UVS: "Undefined", "Beschluss", "Erkenntnis", "Bescheid". Justiz: "Ordentliche Erledigung (Sachentscheidung)", "Zurückweisung mangels erheblicher Rechtsfrage", "Zurückweisung aus anderen Gründen", "Verstärkter Senat". AsylGH: "Undefined", "Beschluss", "Erkenntnis", "ErkenntnisGrundsatzentscheidung", "ErkenntnisVerstaerkterSenat", "Bescheid". Ubas: "Undefined", "Bescheid", "Ersatzbescheid". Gbk: "Undefined", "Einzelfallpruefungsergebnis", "Gutachten". Dsk: "Undefined", "BescheidBeschwerde", "BescheidAmtswegigesPruefverfahren", "VerwaltungsstraferkenntnisVerwarnungErmahnung", "BescheidWissenschaftStatistikArchiv", "BescheidInternatDatenverkehr", "BescheidAkkreditierungZertifizierung", "BescheidVerhaltensregeln", "BescheidWarnung", "BescheidRegistrierung", "BescheidSonstiger", "Empfehlung", "BescheidIFG", "Verfahrensschriftsaetze". Values VfGH, VwGH, BVwG, LVwG, Justiz, Dsk, Gbk validated client-side. Values applications (including AsylGH Ubas) passed API -validated server-side . index_term Optional index term (Index). collection_number Optional collection number (Sammlungsnummer). title Optional title (Titel), used Normenliste. document_kind Optional document kind (Typ), used Normenliste. publication_organ Optional publication organ (Kundmachungsorgan), used Normenliste. legal_area Optional legal area (Rechtsgebiet), used Justiz. specialist_area Optional specialist area (Fachgebiet), used Justiz. court Optional court (Gericht), used Justiz. legal_principle_number Optional legal principle number (Rechtssatznummer), used Justiz. legal_assessment Optional legal assessment (RechtlicheBeurteilung), used Justiz. ruling Optional ruling text (Spruch), used Justiz Ubas. citation Optional citation (Fundstelle), used Justiz. changed_since_period Optional change window (AenderungenSeitPeriode), used Justiz. federal_state Optional federal state (Bundesland), used Lvwg Uvs. deciding_authority Optional deciding authority (EntscheidendeBehoerde), used Dsk, Dok, Pvak, Verg. commission Optional commission (Kommission), used Gbk. senate Optional senate (Senat), used Gbk. discrimination_ground Optional discrimination ground (Diskriminierungsgrund), used Gbk. Accepted German values: "Geschlecht", "Ethnische Zugehörigkeit", "Religion", "Weltanschauung", "Alter", "Sexuelle Orientierung", "Behinderung", "Mehrfachdiskriminierung". English aliases: "gender"/"sex" -> "Geschlecht", "ethnicity"/ "ethnic_origin" -> "EthnischeZugehoerigkeit", "religion" -> "Religion", "worldview" -> "Weltanschauung", "age" -> "Alter", "sexual_orientation" -> "SexuelleOrientierung", "disability" -> "Behinderung", "multiple"/ "multiple_discrimination" -> "Mehrfachdiskriminierung". Matching case-insensitive ignores spaces, underscores, hyphens. author Optional author (Verfasser), used Ubas. short_title Optional short title (Kurzbezeichnung), used Umse. domain Optional domain (Bereich), used Bks. in_ris_since Optional RIS recency filter (ImRisSeit). Accepts API values ("Undefined", "EinerWoche", "ZweiWochen", "EinemMonat", "DreiMonaten", "SechsMonaten", "EinemJahr") English aliases ("one_week", "two_weeks", "one_month", "three_months", "six_months", "one_year"). search_decision_text Optional flag decision text search (SucheInEntscheidungstexten). search_legal_principles Optional flag legal principles search (SucheInRechtssaetzen). flags omitted, document types searched. one flag given, defaults complement, single flag selects exactly one document type (e.g. search_decision_text = FALSE searches legal principles ). Setting FALSE error. sort_by Sort column (SortierungSortedByColumn). omitted, defaults "Datum" (decision date) applications except Normenliste, whose sortable column "Kurzinformation" — sort parameters omitted API default order applies. VfGH VwGH value validated client-side "Geschaeftszahl", "Datum", "Art", "Typ" (English aliases "business_number"/"case_number", "decision_date", "decision_type", "document_type"); Normenliste "Kurzinformation" (alias "brief_info"); applications pass value API -. sort_direction Sort direction (SortierungSortDirection): "Ascending" "Descending". Defaults "Descending" whenever sort column effect. base_url API base URL. Defaults ris_base_url(), can overridden session via options(risAT.base_url = ...).

text: Initial development version. full-text query norm arguments now accept ODER operator; translated client-side RIS-native full-text operator. Text inside single-quoted exact phrases left untouched. Fixed API schema-validation errors GBK filters: senate, federal commission, multi-word discrimination_ground values (“Ethnische Zugehörigkeit”, “Sexuelle Orientierung”) sent RIS-website display form; now mapped OGD API enum values (/II/III, BundesGleichbehandlungskommission, EthnischeZugehoerigkeit, SexuelleOrientierung). Accepted user inputs unchanged, API enum spellings now accepted input . requests now throttled client-side (30 requests per minute) courtesy public RIS OGD API. search perform functions always fetch every page scope; max_pages argument cap truncate result set. ris_req_case_law() ris_search_case_law() gained sort_by sort_direction arguments (previously hard-coded date descending, remains default). New ris_base_url() helper single source API base URL; can overridden per session via options(risAT.base_url = ...). New accessors ris_search_url() ris_app_url() retrieve RIS website URLs attached search results. Bundesrecht requests now send package-identifying User-Agent header Judikatur requests. Validation errors now carry condition classes (risat_invalid_argument, risat_api_error, risat_truncated_results) can caught tryCatch(). decision_date (court/title general metadata block) now returned dedicated columns; decision_date parsed Date. Requests now identify package via User-Agent header.
